% Pattern: restate/option. A theorem printed again before its proof with
% only a reference as its option, as \begin{repthm}[\ref{a}], restates the
% item of the label, and the proof after it proves the restatement. Seen in
% the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
% want repthm-1 statement/theorem - origin=restated status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=repthm-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem*{repthm}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{Results}

\begin{theorem}\label{t:main}
A monotone sequence that is bounded has a limit.
\end{theorem}

\section{Proof}

\begin{repthm}[\ref{t:main}]
Every bounded monotone sequence converges.
\end{repthm}

\begin{proof}
Take the supremum of the terms.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
